$comment: Template: one proposal per source. kb.py apply writes facts with a final basis; tentative facts and ambiguous mentions are held in the inbox. Every decision is held until its binds_to settles: released when all bound PRs merge / stories complete (or the operator confirms an operator-bound one), dropped when any is abandoned.

edges.edge: member_of | owns | works_with | defines | part_of | depends_on | grounded_by | decided_by | supersedes | relates_to
